title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.06714v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent systems for optimizing prompts, programs, and ML workflows typically rely on explicit outer-loop controllers such as evolutionary search, bandits, or textual-gradient methods. We ask a fundamentally different question: how much of this search policy can be internalized by a single tool-using agent? We present ReASearch, a unified framework for reasoning-driven optimization in which the agent autonomously decides what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to make, and when to verify or restart. Rather than serving only as a proposal generator guided by hand-designed heuristics, the agent actively analyzes outcomes, allocates budget, and refines its strategy over long horizons through persistent memory. translated_title: 优化器即智能体：跨提示、程序与机器学习工作流的推理驱动搜索
translated_abstract: 近期用于优化提示、程序和机器学习工作流的系统通常依赖显式的外循环控制器，例如进化搜索、多臂老虎机或文本梯度方法。我们提出了一个根本不同的问题：这种搜索策略有多少能够被单个使用工具的智能体所内化？我们提出了ReASearch，一个推理驱动的统一优化框架，其中智能体自主决定评估什么内容、如何诊断失败、做出哪些编辑以及何时验证或重启。该智能体不再仅仅充当由人工设计启发式规则引导的提案生成器，而是主动分析结果、分配预算，并通过持久记忆在长周期中不断改进自身策略。通过共享的智能体循环和领域特定工具，ReASearch以完全相同的框架来优化提示、程序和机器学习工作流。在14个多样化任务上，它与现有方法具有竞争力，且在大多数情况下表现更优。
tldr: 提出ReASearch统一框架，用单个具备工具使用与持久记忆能力的推理智能体内化整个搜索策略，取代显式外循环控制器，以同一套框架自主优化提示、程序和机器学习工作流。
en_tdlr: ReASearch unifies prompt, program, and ML workflow optimization by internalizing the search policy into a single tool-using reasoning agent with persistent memory, replacing explicit outer-loop controllers.
